description: This file defines the user interface for a private GPT application using Gradio and FastAPI. It includes UI components, mode management, file ingestion, and chat handling logic.

classes.name: Modes
classes.description: Enumeration of different operational modes for the UI: RAG, Search, Basic Chat, Summarize.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Data model representing a source document with file, page, and text, including a static method to curate sources from chunks.

classes.name: PrivateGptUi
classes.description: Singleton class managing the UI components, interactions, and integration with backend services for the private GPT application.

methods.name: _chat
methods.description: Handles chat interactions based on the selected mode, streaming responses, and managing conversation history.

methods.name: _get_default_system_prompt
methods.description: Returns the default system prompt string based on the current mode.

methods.name: _get_default_mode_explanation
methods.description: Provides a textual explanation of the current mode.

methods.name: _set_system_prompt
methods.description: Sets the system prompt used in the chat interface.

methods.name: _set_current_mode
methods.description: Updates the current mode and resets related prompts and explanations.

methods.name: _list_ingested_files
methods.description: Returns a list of ingested files for display.

methods.name: _upload_file
methods.description: Handles uploading and ingesting new files, replacing existing ones if necessary.

methods.name: _selected_a_file
methods.description: Sets a file as selected based on user input.

methods.name: _build_ui_blocks
methods.description: Constructs the Gradio UI layout with all components and event handlers.

methods.name: get_ui_blocks
methods.description: Returns the Gradio Blocks object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: mount_in_app
methods.description: Mounts the Gradio UI into a FastAPI application at a specified path.
